description: A phone lies on the bed next to a coiled white charging cable in front of a pillow. The right hand reaches to the phone on the right side, lifts it, and holds it up while the left hand grasps the cable connector and guides it to the phone’s charging port; the left hand pushes the plug in as the right hand steadies the phone, then the right hand sets the now-plugged-in phone back down on the bed.
